interchanges.ramp_advisory_source: OpenStreetMap maxspeed:advisory on the motorway_link way at this exit (read; directional suffix resolved from OSM way direction into leg direction), from a local Geofabrik extract, accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
interchanges.ramp_control_source: OpenStreetMap highway=traffic_signals/highway=stop node within 120 m of the walked terminal node where this exit's ramp chain ends (read; the walk supplies the node, the tag supplies the control), from a local Geofabrik extract, accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
interchanges.ramp_far_end_source: derived: this exit's motorway_link chains walked from the gore in a local Geofabrik extract, accessed 2026-06-23. 'motorway' means every chain merges onto a highway=motorway way; 'surface' means at least one chain ends off the motorway network: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
interchanges.ramp_length_source: derived from OpenStreetMap geometry: summed node-to-node distance along this exit's motorway_link way(s), from the gore node where the ramp leaves the motorway to the nearest node where it ends (a public road -- trunk to residential, not a service or private way -- or a dead end, else a motorway merge). Starts at the OSM diverge, at or near the gore, so any deceleration lane before it is not included; direction from the ramp's first edge against the leg. Screened: under 300 ft or over 1.5 mi dropped, not clamped. Local Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
interchanges.ramp_terminal_source: read from OpenStreetMap topology: the node where the same walk that measures ramp_length ends (the public crossroad or dead end the motorway_link way reaches), per direction of travel. Only baked beside a length that passed its screen, and never for a ramp that ends in a merge. Local Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/

interchanges.ramp_length_source: derived from OpenStreetMap geometry: summed node-to-node distance along this exit's motorway_link way(s), from the gore node where the ramp leaves the motorway to the nearest node where it ends (a public road -- trunk to residential, not a service or private way -- or a dead end, else a motorway merge). Starts at the OSM diverge, at or near the gore, so any deceleration lane before it is not included; direction from the ramp's first edge against the leg. Screened: under 300 ft or over 1.5 mi dropped, not clamped. Local Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
interchanges.ramp_terminal_source: read from OpenStreetMap topology: the node where the same walk that measures ramp_length ends (the public crossroad or dead end the motorway_link way reaches), per direction of travel. Only baked beside a length that passed its screen, and never for a ramp that ends in a merge. Local Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/

interchanges.ramp_far_end_source: derived: this exit's motorway_link chains walked from the gore in a local Geofabrik extract, accessed 2026-06-23. 'motorway' means every chain merges onto a highway=motorway way; 'surface' means at least one chain ends off the motorway network: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
interchanges.ramp_control_source: derived from ramp_far_end=motorway: every exit-ramp chain merges onto another motorway, so nothing stops traffic at the far end. Free flow is inferred from read OSM link topology, not from a tag -- OSM does not tag the absence of a control. Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23
interchanges.ramp_length_source: derived from OpenStreetMap geometry: summed node-to-node distance along this exit's motorway_link way(s), from the gore node where the ramp leaves the motorway to the nearest node where it ends (a public road -- trunk to residential, not a service or private way -- or a dead end, else a motorway merge). Starts at the OSM diverge, at or near the gore, so any deceleration lane before it is not included; direction from the ramp's first edge against the leg. Screened: under 300 ft or over 1.5 mi dropped, not clamped. Local Geofabrik extract accessed 2026-06-23: https://www.openstreetmap.org/
